model: C - pick a room, scrub its own full day
principle: one room open at a time; the slider position IS the lighting (clock == light), so no desync is possible
flip: the clicked tile grows into the full-screen stage via transform-only FLIP (instant fallback under reduced-motion)
slider_track: a day-arc gradient: cool dawn -> white noon -> amber golden -> ink night (time reads as colour)
perf: the open room's full-viewport glow layer is GPU-promoted (will-change:opacity + translateZ) or the opacity ramp janks ~20%; the night layer is NOT promoted (stacked-layer lesson)
